profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Zscaler || MS SE SJSU’20

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed and tested REST API to design an internal tool using Python Flask and PostgreSQL while following agile practices.
- Implemented features like auto-complete search, responsive list creation, graphs and metrics for visualization using React.js and D3.js
- Designed architecture diagram, workflow diagram, API design document and maintained wiki page for the project.
- Deployed application in production environment using AWS ECS, Fargate, S3, and docker in production environment.

positions.title: Software Developer (Android) Intern
positions.description:
- Developed features on an Android app which enable clients to access the details of the insurance policies sold, all the financial transactions and client information to view and edit it as well as helped them to rectify existing bugs from the app.
- Helped Product manager throughout to update with the current status of the development as well as ideas to make the product better and easy to use.
- Integrated Google and Facebook SDK for easier authentication experience providing better UX for the onboarding of the user to the app.
- Used third-party libraries like ButterKnife, Picasso, Retrofit, MP chart library to increase productivity and providing industry standard experience.
- Worked with the designer to follow Google’s material design guideline system to leverage the latest component as well as providing better UX.

certifications.name: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 6 Programmer
certifications.title: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 6 Programmer

projects.title: OpenHome
projects.description:
- Developed Airbnb simulation in Java Spring Boot, React.js and RDS. Used AOP to send notification email to users using JavaMail API.
- Built a cron job to charge penalty on checkout and perform automatic checkout in the backend.
- Used firebase authentication for Goggle and Facebook Login functionality to facilitate the user for easier sign-in options.
- Developed Time Advancement functionality to test the application features, automatic checkout and penalty calculations.

projects.title: Fashiop
projects.description:
- Implemented microservice architecture for shopping cart functionalities using GoLang for backend and react.js for frontend.
- Deployed APIs on AWS EC2 instances as dockerized applications. Used API Gateway as a single point entry to the microservices.
- Used S3 to store the images and CloudFront to cache the images over all regions. Implemented AKF scale cube through Mongo DB sharding,
cloned and functionally independent APIs.
